allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Kingfa Science & Technology (India) Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 14,40,920 securities pursuant to board resolution passed by Directors of the company by circulation on September 24, 2025

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Kingfa Science & Technology (India) Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates - Intimation of In-principle Approval received for issue and allotment up to 14,40,920 (Fourteen Lakhs Forty Thousand Nine Hundred Twenty) Equity Shares having face value of INR. 10/-(Indian Rupees Ten only) each to be issued on a Preferential Basis.
